description: This Java class 'EventBusMessage' is a utility wrapper for JSON-based messages used in the Hono API via the Vert.x event bus. It provides methods for creating, manipulating, and serializing request and response messages, including handling of AMQP message properties, correlation IDs, and tracing context.

classes.name: EventBusMessage
classes.description: A wrapper for JSON messages used in Hono API communication over Vert.x event bus, supporting creation, property management, and serialization of request and response messages.

methods.name: forOperation
methods.description: Creates a new request message for a specified operation or from an AMQP message.

methods.name: forStatusCode
methods.description: Creates a new response message with a given status code.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Generates a response message replying to a request, copying relevant properties.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an EventBusMessage instance from a JSON object.
